title: Sacred Geometry — Platonic Solids, Vesica, Golden Ratio, Fibonacci, Spirals and Biological Pattern
status: mathematics + history of ideas + biology + project comparison
purpose: Carve exact geometry and observed biological pattern separately from later sacred/esoteric symbolism, then connect only the structurally justified pieces to Potato geometry.
epistemic_rule: Mathematics can establish form and ratios; history can establish who assigned meanings; biology can establish observed developmental patterns. None of these by itself proves metaphysical significance.

plato_timaeus.dodecahedron: fifth solid used for the universe/cosmos in Timaeus 55c

platonic_solids.project_rule: Cube can legitimately compare with stabilized Earth/matter in Platonic reception, but that does not make cube morally negative. Dodecahedron is a historically stronger Platonic cosmic comparator.

vesica_and_euclid.relation: Two equal circles whose centers lie on each other's circumference yield Vesica intersection geometry and an equilateral-triangle construction.
vesica_and_euclid.project_rule: This is exact native geometry; symbolic mappings are layered after the mathematics.

golden_ratio_and_fibonacci.biological_context: Fibonacci numbers and the golden angle occur prominently in many phyllotactic patterns, but plants also exhibit non-Fibonacci and changing patterns.
golden_ratio_and_fibonacci.correction: Do not claim potato vines, roots or tuber rings follow Fibonacci/golden spirals without species/organ-specific measurement. The older Great Book statement is poetic unless independently measured.

project_golden_spiral.formula: r(θ)=a e^(bθ), with b=2 ln(φ)/π for quarter-turn scaling by φ
project_golden_spiral.provenance: Recovered as a project mathematical construction; not a universal biological/cosmic law.
project_golden_spiral.distinction: Logarithmic spiral != helix != ring != vortex != phyllotactic parastichy.

dodecahedron_decagon_bridge.exact_statement: A regular dodecahedron and its dual icosahedron have fivefold axes; appropriate plane sections perpendicular to a fivefold axis can produce decagonal symmetry/cross-sections.
dodecahedron_decagon_bridge.project_use: Useful bridge between 3D Platonic/cosmic family and 2D tenfold boundary geometry; does not make every decagon a hidden dodecahedron.

merkaba_geometry_boundary.historical: Merkavah means chariot and belongs to Ezekiel/heikhalot Jewish mystical history.
merkaba_geometry_boundary.modern_esoteric: The popular star-tetrahedron 'Merkaba' geometry is a later esoteric/New Age construction and must not be retrojected into Ezekiel.
merkaba_geometry_boundary.project: Potato=vehicle / driver distinction and counter-rotation models are project developments, not historical Merkavah doctrine.

tests: Is the claim exact mathematics, measured biology, historical symbolism or project interpretation?
Which coordinate/construction produces the claimed angle/ratio?
Does the biological object actually show the pattern being claimed?
Is a later esoteric diagram being backdated into an older religious text?
